content.text: Image point coordinates are in [y, x] format, where y is the vertical axis, x is the horizontal axis; their values are normalized from 0 to 1000, where [0 0] is the top left, [1000 1000] is the bottom right. Which point can be used to stir eggs? A) [633 567] B) [840 745] C) [715 223] D) [725 237] Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
